lines.beaver_en: You're not up yet? Are you okay?
lines.learner: 아주머니, 저 좀 아파요. 머리가 아파요.
lines.en: Ma'am, I'm a bit sick. My head hurts.
lines.roman: ajumeoni, jeo jom apayo. meoriga apayo.

lines.beaver_en: Oh my, your face is red. Do you have a fever?
lines.en: Yes, I have a fever. My throat hurts too.

lines.beaver: 감기에 걸렸나 봐요. 어제 늦게 잤어요?
lines.beaver_en: You must have caught a cold. Did you go to bed late last night?
lines.beaver_roman: gamgie geollyeonna bwayo. eoje neutge jasseoyo?
lines.en: Yes, I'm so tired because I'm busy these days.

lines.beaver_en: Are you going to school today?
lines.en: No, I want to rest just for today.

lines.learner: 조금 멀어요. 버스로 삼십 분 걸려요.
lines.en: It's a bit far. It takes 30 minutes by bus.
lines.roman: jogeum meoreoyo. beoseuro samsip bun geollyeoyo.

lines.beaver: 그럼 오늘은 약만 먹고 푹 자요.
lines.beaver_en: Then just take medicine and sleep well today.
lines.beaver_roman: geureom oneureun yangman meokgo puk jayo.
lines.learner: 네, 감기약이 있어요. 큰 병은 아니에요.
lines.en: Yes, I have cold medicine. It's not a serious illness.
lines.roman: ne, gamgiyagi isseoyo. keun byeongeun anieyo.

lines.beaver: 죽을 만들어 줄게요. 먹을 수 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: I'll make you porridge. Can you eat?
lines.beaver_roman: jugeul mandeureo julgeyo. meogeul su isseoyo?
lines.en: Yes, just a little, please. I have no appetite.

lines.beaver_en: Got it. Is your room a bit cold?
lines.learner: 네, 조금 추워요. 보일러 좀 켜 주세요.
lines.en: Yes, a little cold. Please turn on the heater.
lines.roman: ne, jogeum chuwoyo. boilleo jom kyeo juseyo.

lines.beaver_en: Don't overdo it today. Take a break from studying too.
lines.en: Okay, don't worry. I'll sleep well.

lines.beaver_en: If you're still sick tomorrow, be sure to see a doctor.
lines.en: Okay, thank you. Then I'll go to the hospital.
